purpose: Add eight nonduplicate public-domain hymn texts with themed Scripture links and playable public-domain MIDI tunes through the repeatable source-verifying importer.
guardrails: The importer rejects hymn ids and titles already present in the complete verified catalog.
The importer extracts the exact source stanzas and refrain without modern rewriting.
The retained page must explicitly mark both the hymn text and the selected tune Public Domain.
The exact MIDI and retained rights page are recorded with SHA-256 checksums.
Playback is synthesized from MIDI; no third-party performance recording is included.
